revenueProvenance.basis: Issuer total consolidated revenue, including banking interest income when acquired banking operations enter consolidation; not non-bank revenue alone. Banking interest expense is an operating expense, never added back as corporate finance cost.
revenueProvenance.operatingIncomeBasis: Explicit reported operating profit/loss after banking interest expense and disclosed depreciation/amortization; not adjusted EBITDA.
revenueProvenance.businessScope: Lottery hardware/distribution and ancillary services, Macau digital payments and full-scale banking. Significant banking/payment exposure makes an undifferentiated corporate DCF inappropriate; requires segment valuation, not a bank model inferred here.

annual.notes: Separate imputed interest expense on deferred consideration 1675 is not included in the finance-cost subtotal 2860; do not silently equate finance cost to total financing expense.

limitations: 8279-lottery-payments-bank-consolidated-interest-in-revenue links FY2025/FY2026 and September 2024/2025 H1: each includes Ant Bank from its actual consolidation date, banking interest in revenue and bank interest expense in operating costs. The official interim identifies completion on 2 September 2024. FY2025-minus-September-2024 H1 and FY2026-minus-September-2025 H1 are valid actual-scope H2 amounts; aligned TTM is also supported. Shorter acquisition-year contributions are not a pro-forma/organic comparison.

Pre-bank records, including the fifteen-month FY2024 and December 2023 I2, remain outside the bank-consolidated group. Same group never turns a twelve-month I2 into a FY/H2 or overrides period-start/duration requirements.

Provider annual 2023-12-31 is a twelve-month second interim during the fifteen-month FY2024 transition (2023-01-01 to 2024-03-31), not the final FY. Preserve it only as interimPeriods, not annual or H1.
Provider labels quarterly observations using calendar quarters. No synthetic March/June/December H1 periods: FY2025/FY2026 H1 ends September; pre-transition H1 ends June.
Net finance income in older statements is not gross interest income or expense. Leave those component fields unreviewed/null rather than recycling provider net finance figures as interest.

No GP/COGS subtotal is presented; purchases and inventories alone are not consolidated COGS. D&A is explicitly expensed on the face of the statement. All EPS values are HKD per share, including potentially negative diluted EPS despite positive basic EPS caused by instruments as reported.
A full twelve-month banking contribution is not like-for-like with the shorter banking contribution in the FY2025 comparative; compatible presentation tags do not imply organic growth.
